reviewedBy: Claude Opus 5 — proved the admin bypass against production before and after the fix
method: Verified the exposure empirically rather than from code: created a confirmed Supabase account that was on no allowlist, signed in through the real login form, and loaded /admin/tags, /admin/albums and /analytics — all 200, full content, cache-busted and reproduced directly against the pages.dev origin with the router removed. Root cause was isAllowedAdmin returning true when ADMIN_EMAILS is unset, combined with disable_signup=false on the Supabase project. Made the check fail closed and confirmed the visitor-facing gallery is untouched: signed out, reloaded /photography anonymously, and saw the same 8 albums, the FIND YOUR PHOTOS heading and unchanged search copy. /analytics still 302s to /login for anonymous visitors. No reader-facing text changed in this pass.
